acceptance_scope: Retained browser evidence only, not strict original-game A0 parity.
visual_findings: All four views show the tactical HUD frame.
All four views show red, green, and blue projectile traces.
All four views show tractor and gravity fields.
No unintended HUD or field clipping is visible.
No obvious blank or corrupt surface is visible.

evidence_checks.framebuffer_probe: Nonzero pixels for each projectile color selector in both factions and viewports.
evidence_checks.field_probe: Tractor resource 3623 at frame 3 and gravity resource 3525 at frame 5.

limitations: The review inspected retained screenshots and JSON evidence rather than launching a fresh browser session.
Projectile traces are only a few pixels, particularly at 640x480, and are corroborated by framebuffer probes.
Static captures do not establish animation, interaction behavior, or original-game parity.
